caption: The drawing depicts a square textile design with a predominantly floral and geometric pattern. The central area of the composition features four heart-shaped motifs outlined with small green and red dots, arranged symmetrically around a circular cluster of red, green, and brown floral elements in the very center. Surrounding these hearts are repeated motifs of stylized red flowers with green leaves and stems, creating a dense and balanced layout. The border consists of a continuous band of small red flowers and green leaves, all enclosing the main pattern. The background color of the textile is beige or off-white, and the entire pattern is rendered using primarily red, green, and minor accents of brown. There is a thin red line framing the entire square, and the drawing is signed "Suzanne Roy" in the bottom right corner outside the main design.
title: Applique Quilt
